candidates.snippet: 1856: Begins Plant Hybridization Experiments - Mendel began his seminal experiments on plant hybridization, focusing on pea plants to understand inheritance patterns. 1865: Presents Findings on Heredity - Mendel presented his findings on plant hybridization and the laws of inheritance to the Natural History Society of Brno. 1866: Publishes "Experiments in Plant Hybridization" - Mendel published his groundbreaking paper, "Experiments in Plant Hybridization," detailing his laws of heredity. 1868: Becomes Abbot of Augustinian Monastery - Mendel was elected abbot of the Augustinian Monastery in Brno, a significant administrative role.
